finalText:
Fixed. The build fails because `config.js` used a shallow `Object.assign` to merge per-package overrides onto the defaults, so any package overriding `output` or `sourcemap` — `@acme/api`, `@acme/web`, `@acme/cli` — wiped out the sibling keys (`output.dir`, `sourcemap.mode`) it didn't mention, tripping the `EBUNDLE07 config-incomplete` check.

I changed `resolveRelease` in `packages/shared/config.js` to merge `output` and `sourcemap` one level deep instead of replacing them wholesale. The build now exits 0 with 5 warnings, 0 errors, and `verify.js` confirms the config merges correctly.
